/// What a `Dynamic` holds, named the way Luau's `type()` names it.
export const enum DynamicKind {
    /// A `bool`.
    boolean = 0,

    /// An `f64`.
    number = 1,

    /// A `string`.
    string = 2,

    /// A table, with an array part and a string keyed part.
    table = 3,

    /// A class instance, read back with `asRef`.
    userdata = 4,
}

/// A value whose type is only known at run time: a boolean, number, string,
/// table or class instance, the way a Luau value typed `any` is. Null stands
/// for nil.
///
/// A table has an array part and a string keyed part, as a Luau table does, so
/// reading one as an array and as a map shares its storage. The readers take a
/// `Dynamic?` and raise an error when the value is not of the kind asked for.
///
/// ```as
/// import { Dynamic } from "rive/dynamic";
///
/// let point = Dynamic.newTable();
/// point.set("x", Dynamic.fromNumber(3));
/// let x = Dynamic.asNumber(point.get("x")); // 3
/// let missing = point.get("y"); // null
/// ```
export class Dynamic {
    /// The kind of value held.
    readonly kind: DynamicKind;

    /// Returns a boolean value.
    static fromBool(value: bool): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a number value.
    static fromNumber(value: f64): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a string value.
    static fromString(value: string): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a boolean value, or null when `value` is null.
    static fromBoolOrNull(value: Box<bool>?): Dynamic?;

    /// Returns a number value, or null when `value` is null.
    static fromNumberOrNull(value: Box<f64>?): Dynamic?;

    /// Returns a string value, or null when `value` is null.
    static fromStringOrNull(value: string?): Dynamic?;

    /// Returns an empty table.
    static newTable(): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a table whose array part is `items`, shared rather than copied.
    static fromArray(items: Array<Dynamic?>): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a table whose string keyed part is `entries`, shared rather
    /// than copied.
    static fromMap(entries: Map<string, Dynamic?>): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a table whose array part holds a copy of `items`.
    static fromNumbers(items: Array<f64>): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a table copying `items`, or null when it is null.
    static fromNumbersOrNull(items: Array<f64>?): Dynamic?;

    /// Returns a table whose string keyed part holds a copy of `entries`.
    static fromNumberMap(entries: Map<string, f64>): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a value holding the class instance `value`, which `asRef`
    /// reads back as the same `T`.
    static fromRef<T>(value: T): Dynamic;

    /// Returns a value holding `value`, or null when it is null.
    static fromRefOrNull<T>(value: T?): Dynamic?;

    /// Returns the class instance held, which must have been stored as a `T`.
    static asRef<T>(value: Dynamic?): T;

    /// Returns the class instance held, or null for nil.
    static asRefOrNull<T>(value: Dynamic?): T?;

    /// Returns the name Luau's `type()` gives the value: `"nil"`,
    /// `"boolean"`, `"number"`, `"string"`, `"table"` or `"userdata"`.
    static typeName(value: Dynamic?): string;

    /// Returns false for nil and false, true for anything else, as a Luau
    /// condition reads the value.
    static truthy(value: Dynamic?): bool;

    /// Returns whether `a` and `b` are equal the way Luau's `==` compares
    /// them: booleans, numbers and strings by value, tables and class
    /// instances by identity.
    static equals(a: Dynamic?, b: Dynamic?): bool;

    /// Returns a negative number, zero or a positive number as `a` orders
    /// before, with or after `b`, the way Luau's `<` compares two numbers or
    /// two strings. Raises an error for any other pair.
    static compare(a: Dynamic?, b: Dynamic?): i32;

    /// Returns `value` when it is truthy and `fallback()` otherwise, Luau's
    /// `value or fallback`.
    static orElse(value: Dynamic?, fallback: () => Dynamic?): Dynamic?;

    /// Returns `next()` when `value` is truthy and `value` otherwise, Luau's
    /// `value and next`.
    static andThen(value: Dynamic?, next: () => Dynamic?): Dynamic?;

    /// Returns the value as Luau's `tostring` prints it.
    static toText(value: Dynamic?): string;

    /// Returns the length Luau's `#` gives: a string's UTF-8 bytes or the
    /// table's array part length.
    static length(value: Dynamic?): f64;

    /// Returns the boolean held.
    static asBool(value: Dynamic?): bool;

    /// Returns the boolean held, or null for nil.
    static asBoolOrNull(value: Dynamic?): Box<bool>?;

    /// Returns the number held.
    static asNumber(value: Dynamic?): f64;

    /// Returns the number held, or null for nil.
    static asNumberOrNull(value: Dynamic?): Box<f64>?;

    /// Returns the string held.
    static asString(value: Dynamic?): string;

    /// Returns the string held, or null for nil.
    static asStringOrNull(value: Dynamic?): string?;

    /// Returns the table's array part, shared rather than copied.
    static asArray(value: Dynamic?): Array<Dynamic?>;

    /// Returns the table's array part, or null for nil.
    static asArrayOrNull(value: Dynamic?): Array<Dynamic?>?;

    /// Returns the table's string keyed part, shared rather than copied.

    static asMapOrNull(value: Dynamic?): Map<string, Dynamic?>?;

    /// Returns a copy of the table's array part as numbers.

    /// Returns a copy of the table's array part as numbers, or null for nil.
    static asNumbersOrNull(value: Dynamic?): Array<f64>?;

    /// Returns a copy of the table's string keyed part as numbers.

    /// Sets the entry under `key` in this table's string keyed part; null

    set(key: string, value: Dynamic?): void;

    /// Appends `value` to this table's array part.

    /// Sets the item at the zero based `index` of this table's array part,
